name: kael
discipline_notes: Musashi dual-blade style: off-hand blade parry paired with long blade counter-strikes.

iaido_quick_draw.title: Iaijutsu Quick-Draw (Nukitsuke)
iaido_quick_draw.posture: Low seated or crouched stance (Seiza/Iai-goshi), hand bracing saya (scabbard), thumb pushing tsuba (guard).

timing_breakdown.koiguchi_no_koi: Frame 0: Scabbard unlocked, blade turns edge-up.

iaido_quick_draw.engine_note: LIVE as Iai Quick-Draw (Back+Heavy, 269) — SHEET_V 284 adds the spec's guard_pierce (unblockable flag).

kesagiri_diagonal.title: Kesagiri (Diagonal Shoulder-to-Hip Cut)
kesagiri_diagonal.posture: Starts in Hasso-no-kamae (blade high beside head), drives downward through core rotation.

timing_breakdown.hasso_stance: Frame 6: Hands high at right ear.
timing_breakdown.hip_drive: Frame 7: Leading hip rotates on 45-degree angle.
timing_breakdown.hasuji_alignment: Frame 8: Edge alignment collarbone to hip.

kesagiri_diagonal.engine_note: Already the live neutral heavy arc (heavy_i1..5 kenjutsu exposure law). No engine change.

tsuki_thrust.title: Chudan Tsuki (Center Piercing Thrust)
tsuki_thrust.posture: Chudan-no-kamae, tip at throat, minimal body movement.

timing_breakdown.tsuki_lunge: Frame 13: Explosive step, tip into chest.
timing_breakdown.retraction: Frames 15-16: Sharp pull back to center.

tsuki_thrust.engine_note: LIVE as Drive Stab (Fwd+Heavy, xstab cells) — SHEET_V 284 adds the spec's armor_pierce (unblockable flag).

gyaku_kesa_rising.title: Gyaku Kesa (Reverse Rising Cut)
gyaku_kesa_rising.posture: Waki-kamae (blade hidden behind hip), sweeping upward to catch low attacks.

timing_breakdown.waki_hide: Frames 17-18: Blade hidden behind right hip.
timing_breakdown.recovery: Frame 22: Settles into Jodan high guard.

gyaku_kesa_rising.engine_note: BUILT at SHEET_V 284: Executioner Up+Heavy (the empty slot) — rising launcher off heavy_i1/i2 cells, launch -400.

martial_style.name: Niten Ichi-ryu / Ryotojutsu (Long + Short Sword)
martial_style.focus: Simultaneous parry-and-strike, dual-weapon coordination inspired by Miyamoto Musashi.

etiquette.reiho: Bow of respect before and after engagement.
etiquette.zanshin: State of relaxed alertness preserved after delivering a strike; never drop guard immediately.
etiquette.chiburi: Rhythmic flick of the blade to clear blood before re-sheathing.
etiquette.noto: Smooth, deliberate re-sheathing into the scabbard (Saya).
